frozen_prompt:
Search the live web for first-party merchant product-detail pages that can serve as rival price comparisons for these five products from a US custom-workwear store. Rules:
- Return up to 5 rival pages for each source product.
- Each result must be a direct product-detail page on the merchant's own domain.
- The page must currently show a finite positive per-item or per-unit price in USD.
- Exclude wearform.com, marketplaces, directories, search/listing/category pages, articles, PDFs, social media, quote-only pages, and pages where the only number is a cart, setup, order, or quantity total.
- Exact branded items and close functional substitutes are allowed, but label each exact, close, weak, or wrong.
- Multiple distinct rivals for one source product are welcome.
- Do not invent URLs or prices.
Source products:
1. Allie Custom Tote Bag; Port Authority; SKU B118WL; 11 oz garment-washed cotton canvas, lined tote, interior zip pocket, webbing handles, 15.75 x 13.25 x 3.5 inches; source price USD 31.60.
2. 3-Pocket Waist Custom Apron; Port Authority; SKU A515WL; 7 oz cotton twill, stain release, three pouch pockets plus pen pocket, 23 x 11 inches; source price USD 18.54.
3. Cruz Trucker Custom Cap; TravisMathew; SKU TM1MU423WL; structured mid-profile mesh-back trucker cap, Flexfit 110, adjustable snapback; source price USD 42.88.
4. FlexFit Delta Custom Cap; Port Authority; SKU C938WL; structured mid-profile poly/spandex stretch-fit cap, moisture-wicking, water-repellent, Permacurv bill; source price USD 30.88.
5. Hi-Visibility Sun Neck Gaiter; Paragon; SKU 13171; 3.5 oz microfiber polyester, Safety Green ANSI background, moisture/odor management, UPF 50+; source price USD 8.98.
Return JSON only in this shape:
{"provider":"...","products":[{"source_sku":"...","results":[{"url":"https://...","merchant":"...","visible_title":"...","visible_unit_price":0.00,"currency":"USD","semantic_grade":"exact|close|weak|wrong","short_reason":"..."}]}]}
Use an empty results array if you cannot verify a result.

decision.consumer_screen: Grok Fast had the highest literal one-shot precision at 11/14; Kimi K2.6 Instant produced the most active one-shot offers at 10/16 but suffered repeated timeouts and lower precision; the iterative baseline selected 10/10 active validated offers.
decision.api_provider_ranking: pending controlled API runs with exact model IDs, usage, latency, and cost capture
decision.fairness_note: The baseline used iterative targeted queries and validation while Perplexity, Kimi, and Grok each received one combined consumer prompt. This is an operational workflow screen, not a pure model-only experiment or an equal-budget API benchmark.
